faq.title:
Good to

know.
faq.a1: Pick your game and service, set your current and target rank (or the number of wins), and watch the price update live. After you pay securely with Stripe, a verified booster takes your order and you follow everything from your order page: chat, progress and rank updates.
faq.a2: The price depends on the service and your choices: ranks or number of games, your LP gains, Solo or Duo, and any extras. Our server calculates it and shows it before you pay, in US dollars, euros or pounds. The price you see is the price you pay.
faq.q3: Which games and services are available?
faq.a3: League of Legends, VALORANT and Teamfight Tactics: rank boost, win boost, placement matches and more depending on the game (Arena, champion mastery, normal games, Double Up). Each game page lists what you can order right now, with its starting price.
faq.q4: How can I track my order?
faq.a4: Your order page shows the status, your booster, a private chat and the rank your booster posts after each session. You get a notification when something changes, and you can pause the order whenever you want to play.
faq.q5: What if I am not happy, or need a refund?
faq.a5: When the boost is done, your booster uploads screenshots of the result and our team checks them before completing the order. If something is wrong, report a problem or open a support ticket from your order: our team reviews every case, refunds included.
faq.a6: Your login is encrypted, only your booster can see it during a play session, and every view is logged. VPN and Appear Offline are available. Boosting is against Riot Games' rules, so no service can promise zero risk, but our boosters play carefully to keep it low.
